# Last Week in Swamp Club

> A weekly digest of the swamp extension registry: new extensions, updates, pre-releases, yanks and removals, with a short machine-written summary of each change, plus the week's Swamp Club podcast episode and feed posts.

Each issue covers Monday to Sunday and is published the following Monday. Every issue has an HTML page and a JSON copy with the same content (`issues/<first-day>.html` and `.json`). The JSON index lists every issue, newest first.

Generated automatically from public swamp registry data. Summaries are machine-written descriptions of each change, not reviews, and can be wrong; the registry and the extension's source are authoritative. Authors can leave the digest by adding the `no-digest` label to their extension.

## Issues

- [Index of all issues](https://lastweekinswamp.club/index.json): JSON, newest first
- [Week of Oct 19 – Oct 25, 2026](https://lastweekinswamp.club/issues/2026-10-19.json): JSON; HTML at https://lastweekinswamp.club/issues/2026-10-19.html

## Optional

- [RSS feed](https://lastweekinswamp.club/feed.xml)
- [swamp extension registry](https://swamp-club.com/extensions): the authoritative source for every extension
